glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 羽 (“wings”) + 日 (“sun”) – to learn to fly, to practice flying. In the current form, 日 (“sun”) has changed to 白 (“white”), so the present form is 羽 (“wings”) + 白 (“white”). Alternatively, the original form may have been a phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 彗 + semantic 日 (“sun”).
s_page_origin: Simplified from 習 (elimination of 白 and 羽 → 习) in the 1956 Chinese Character Simplification Scheme by the People's Republic of China. Not known to have existed prior to that.
senses: [xí] (obsolete) to flap (the wings); to flutter; to repeatedly flap the wings
[xí] to practice; to exercise; to review
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 習; s_page_origin explains the simplified 习.
